scope: Exact Qwen4Exp Q4/Q5 expert scheduling and Q8 coltile8 short prefill

implementation.q4: 64 expert-worker CTAs iterate the 512 expert prefix map; each 128-thread logical lane loads paired columns from one Q4_K block while preserving ordered per-column FMAs and the strict wave/block reduction tree
implementation.q5_1: 128 physical threads materialize the same 256 logical partials, then execute the original stride-128-to-1 reduction; 64 expert-worker CTAs iterate the expert map
implementation.q8_0: coltile8/rowbatch4 retains local128 K ownership, ordered FMAs, wave32 shuffle tree, and serial four-wave accumulation
implementation.fallback: HIPENGINE_QWEN4_EXP_EXACT_EXPERT_GRID=0 plus HIPENGINE_QWEN4_EXP_RAW_VARIANT=coltile restores the preceding exact default

profiler.profile_command: HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 HIPENGINE_QWEN4_EXP_EXACT_EXPERT_GRID=64 HIPENGINE_QWEN4_EXP_RAW_VARIANT=coltile8 rocprofv3 --kernel-trace -f csv -o qwen4exp-prefill512-exactnext -d /tmp -- uv run python /tmp/qwen4exp_prefill512_profile.py

validation.focused_command: uv run pytest -q tests/test_gguf_k_gemv.py tests/test_gguf_q4_k_selected_wmma_prefill.py tests/test_qwen4_exp_q5_1_selected.py tests/test_qwen4_exp_runner_moe.py -x
